t: The Router connects multiple XNet controller networks. Attach it to a routing cable network, then publish or consume channels from the linked controllers.
路由器用于连接多个XNet控制器网络。将其接入路由网络线缆后，即可从已连接控制器中发布或订阅频道。
Use routing cables and routing connectors for the router network. Normal colored cables stay local to one controller network.
请使用路由网络线缆与路由连接器搭建路由器网络。普通彩色线缆仅限单个控制器网络内部使用。
